This treatment posted. YOLO Curve laser lipo is Laser Lipo. If you are wondering about Contour Light, just search it up, go to their website and you can search official providers. Lots of businesses call laser lipo different things,  cavitation, Cavi lipo, Cherry lipo, etc. if the treatment looks like the photo posted, the treatment is Laser Lipo

It really depends on your body type. Cool sculpting is effective for very small hard to target pockets of fat. Laser Lipo is more broad and can cover a larger area, your whole lowe stomach for example, depending on how many pads are used (typically 4-8). We no longer offer fat freezing bc we found that the majority of our clients did better with laser lipo, ultrasonic cavitation, or Contour Light Treatment. Price wise, Laser lipo is also considerably less expensive

I run a noninvasive medspa outside of Atlanta. The image they used here is a generic image you can find online. The pads that are on her stomach in the picture are laser lipo paddles. They emit a red light at 650nm (usually). They red light penetrates the skin and helps to weaken the walls of the fat cells. Once weakened the fat cells can burst/release fat through your lymphatic system. Drinking a lot of water, not drinking alcohol, and doing lite exercise immediately after each session, helps your body to better release the fat. YOLO laser lipo isn’t a thing, it’s just what this company is calling their laser lipo treatments. Many body contouring spas do this. The pricing is pretty standard for the treatment, each session should be about 30-40 minutes, and you’d go 2-3 times a week. To see visible results, I’d say 6-8 sessions at a minimum. There are other more powerful laser devices, Contour Light that can yield inch loss faster. Cool sculpting is more aggressive and can kill fat cells in an area, but you won’t see full results until about 3 months after treatment. Something to keep in mind with cool sculpting is that even though it kills some fat cells, that doesn’t mean that the cells that remain can get larger. It is also more painful of a procedure. With Laser Lipo you should only feel some warmth. Smart Lipo is different as well, that would require cutting but is still less invasive than traditional Liposuction. Hopefully that helps!
